results.name: Sugarcube Corner
results.description:
My 3D interpretation of the candy and sweets shop Sugarcube Corner from My Little Pony: Friendship is magic! 

This model was originally made in 2013 and has now been totally overhauled in 2020 with new UVs, better textures, and topology. (Originally my first model uploaded to Sketchfab!)

Model made in Blender, textures in Substance Painter.

results.description:
Candy, also called sweets or lollies, is a confection that features sugar as a principal ingredient. The category, called sugar confectionery, encompasses any sweet confection, including chocolate, chewing gum, and sugar candy. Vegetables, fruit, or nuts which have been glazed and coated with sugar are said to be candied.

Info Link: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Candy
